SELECT i.id, i.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.marketplace, COALESCE(i.currency, s.currency) AS currency, i.seller_sku, COALESCE(i.fnsku, l.fnsku) AS fnsku, COALESCE(i.asin, l.platform_item_id) AS asin, COALESCE(i.title, l.title) AS title, i.snapshot_date, i.available_qty, i.inbound_qty, i.reserved_qty, i.unfulfillable_qty, i.researching_qty, i.age_0_90 AS age0To90, i.age_91_180 AS age91To180, i.age_181_270 AS age181To270, i.age_271_365 AS age271To365, i.age_365_plus AS age365Plus, i.age_source, i.units_shipped_30 AS unitsShipped30, i.report_storage_fee, l.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, l.price, COALESCE(so.qty, 0) AS sold30, d.length_cm, d.width_cm, d.height_cm, d.weight_kg FROM ecom_fba_inventory i JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = i.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = i.store_id AND l.seller_sku = i.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_fba_item_dim d ON d.store_id = i.store_id AND d.seller_sku = i.seller_sku LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{since} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku ) so ON so.store_id = i.store_id AND so.seller_sku = i.seller_sku
i.store_id = #{storeId}
AND (i.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.fnsku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.asin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY i.store_id, i.seller_sku

SELECT ib.store_id, it.seller_sku, COALESCE(ib.receive_date, ib.ship_date) AS receive_date, SUM(it.received_qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1)) AS qty FROM ecom_inbound ib JOIN ecom_inbound_item it ON it.inbound_id = ib.id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = ib.store_id AND l.seller_sku = it.seller_sku WHERE ib.store_id = #{storeId} AND ib.status = 'RECEIVED' AND it.seller_sku IS NOT NULL AND it.part_main = 1 AND it.received_qty > 0 GROUP BY ib.store_id, it.seller_sku, COALESCE(ib.receive_date, ib.ship_date) ORDER BY receive_date DESC

SELECT l.seller_sku, l.platform_item_id AS asin, l.fnsku, l.title, ps.snapshot_date, ps.fulfillable_qty, ps.inbound_qty, ps.reserved_qty, ps.unfulfillable_qty, CASE WHEN l.material_id IS NULL OR s.platform_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(st.qty) FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.material_id = l.material_id AND st.warehouse_id = s.platform_warehouse_id), 0) / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) END AS system_qty FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_platform_stock ps ON ps.store_id = l.store_id AND ps.seller_sku = l.seller_sku WHERE l.store_id = #{storeId} AND l.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' AND l.status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY l.seller_sku
